The evidence supports a relationship where Ent-Gloeosteretriol may modulate the activity of these secondary targets, potentially through a network of interactions that ultimately lead to the regulation of Fusion glycoprotein F0. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the molecular interactions involved, with Ent-Gloeosteretriol acting as a potential modulator in this network.
